_stage: Stage 1 preregistration package — BUILD ONLY, zero model calls
_note: Every value here is FROZEN by the ratified instruction, not chosen after seeing fixtures. selector_config_hash is meaningful only because these are concrete.

algorithm_steps: 1. Start from the candidate span [start_char, end_char) in the canonical text.
2. If the parser deterministically yields a containing block boundary, expand to that containing block.
3. Continue adding ADJACENT COMPLETE blocks (alternating outward) while total context length <= max_context_chars.
4. If no reliable block boundary is available, fall back to a fixed character window of max_context_chars CENTERED on the candidate: allocate half the remaining budget to each side (symmetric).
5. Truncate at document bounds; set truncated_left / truncated_right accordingly.
forbidden_expansions: tuning the budget to reach a known clause (explicitly forbidden by §10)

value_token_detector._discipline: SHAPE ONLY. No lease literal appears in any pattern. These detect the SHAPE of a value token, never a specific figure. A pattern containing a document value (e.g. a specific dollar amount or percentage from either fixture) would be an answer key and is forbidden by §3 and 427 doctrine.
value_token_detector.value_token_present_rule: true iff (currency matches) OR (percentage matches) OR (rate_phrase matches AND a currency token occurs within rate_adjacency_window_chars of it)

certification_policy._threshold_rationale: Part A §6.3 forbids an implicit majority default. The final threshold is deferred until Part B shows real disagreement distributions; a STRICTER-than-final threshold is safe and preloads nothing. This choice is recorded, not silently defaulted.
certification_policy._completeness_note: Part B cannot measure candidate-generation recall (§3.1/§8.3), therefore NO terminal unsatisfied_* may be emitted. Every no-qualifying-candidate outcome is review_needed_no_qualifying_candidate.

panel.canonical_rule: an attempt is canonical iff actual provider AND actual model equal the frozen primary AND config_hash equals the reviewed config hash
panel.temperature_truth: identity-frozen and config-integrity-asserted, NOT uniformly temperature-zero. A and C transmit temperature 0.0; B (gpt-5.5) is in TEMPERATURE_ONLY_DEFAULT_MODELS and runs at provider-default temperature under the documented 415/416 capability exception (omission is logged, not silent).
panel.reproducibility_claim: identity-frozen panel observed over N=5 canonical attempts per candidate — NOT 'temp 0 therefore identical'

series.certification_rule: parameter certification for series index k consumes ONLY the kth canonical panel result from each admitted candidate for that lease/parameter
series.shortfall_rule: if a required candidate lacks canonical index k, that parameter-series result is reported as a canonical-N shortfall — never filled from another series

parameter_family_labels._discipline: MODEL-FACING TEXT. These name the parameter family neutrally. None states a required charge basis, a required drafting role, or a required value condition — those are the dimensions being measured and must not appear here. None verbatim-matches a distinctive defined term from either fixture, so no label functions as a string-match hint toward a seeded candidate.
parameter_family_labels._dimension_flags_are_schema_fixed: charge_basis_applicability / charge_scope_applicability are fixed by Part A §4.1 per parameter family (not_applicable where the dimension is not a meaningful attribute). They tell the model which dimensions exist for this family; they assert nothing about the answer.

tenant_share.label: tenant's share — the proportion of a charge or cost category allocated to the tenant
tenant_share.charge_basis_applicability: applies — classify the charge basis this passage establishes
tenant_share.charge_scope_applicability: applies — classify the scope the proportion is measured against

building_share.label: building's share — the proportion of a charge or cost category allocated to the building within a larger property
building_share.charge_basis_applicability: applies — classify the charge basis this passage establishes
building_share.charge_scope_applicability: applies — classify the scope the proportion is measured against

base_rent.label: base rent — the recurring rent payable for the premises
base_rent.charge_basis_applicability: does not apply to this parameter family — answer not_applicable
base_rent.charge_scope_applicability: does not apply to this parameter family — answer not_applicable

rent_adjustment_pct.label: rent adjustment rate — the periodic rate at which rent changes over the term
rent_adjustment_pct.charge_basis_applicability: does not apply to this parameter family — answer not_applicable
rent_adjustment_pct.charge_scope_applicability: does not apply to this parameter family — answer not_applicable

prompt_payload_whitelist._rule: §5 — the model-facing payload contains ONLY these fields. Anything else is a leak that voids the measurement while the mechanism appears to work perfectly.
forbidden: any instruction to find a particular kind of share
any statement of a correct answer
any fixture or lease description or name
any correctness hint or grading criterion
the parameter's internal name (tenant_share / base_rent / etc.)
any other candidate's text or the existence of competing candidates

execution_gate.live_run_requires: separate explicit Stage-2 sanction of the exact hashed artifacts
